_purpose: Pre-registered (frozen) cost-based sampler-selection rule and evaluation protocol for Phase 4, Part B. Committed before any Phase-4 validation run. Do not edit after results exist; any change must be a new, separately named rule.
origin: Formulated post hoc in Phase 3 (docs/RESEARCH_FINDINGS.md section 9.5) after inspecting results/asian_qmc/research; this file freezes it for confirmatory testing.

rule.name: cost-model rule
rule.decision: use RQMC-pca if budget_seconds >= n_scrambles * (a_m + n_min_points * b_m), else MC
rule.estimator: CPW-first (level variable Z_1 integrated out exactly)

cost_model.form: t(n) = a_m + b_m * n seconds per scrambling of n points
cost_model.fit: pooled ordinary least squares over constructions {seq, bb, pca} and n in {64, 256, 1024, 4096}, median of 9 repeats each
cost_model.measured: at the start of the evaluation run, on the evaluation machine, for each m in the grid (mc_greeks.asian_qmc.calibrate_rqmc, pooled=True)

comparators.frequency_heuristic: RQMC-pca if m <= 12 else MC (the regime rule learned on Phase-3 training scenarios at 5 ms)
comparators.best_fixed_from_training: RQMC-pca (best fixed sampler on the Phase-3 research grid)
comparators.oracle: per (scenario, budget, Greek): fixed sampler with the smallest measured time-normalised MSE; evaluation only

grid.note: none of these m, K/S0, sigma, T or r values occur in the Phase-2 or Phase-3 Asian grids

rqmc_points_per_scramble: largest power of two with 10 scramblings fitting the budget under the same pooled cost model (unchanged from Phase 3)

cache_protocol.warm: construction matrix L built before the timed region (amortised setup, reported separately); Sobol scrambler construction is always charged
cache_protocol.cold: L built inside the timed region on a fresh cache; measured on one scenario per m, 10 replications per (construction, budget)
cache_protocol.calibration: one-off per machine; its wall time is recorded and reported as amortised setup, not charged per estimate

metrics.wn_mse: (MSE - ref_se^2) * mean measured wall time (pilot-free; full estimation procedure timed)
metrics.overrun: report the distribution of measured wall / budget; flag every estimate with wall > 1.10 * budget

success_criteria.C1: geometric-mean regret of the rule <= 1.25 in every (budget, Greek) cell, aggregated over the 32 scenarios
success_criteria.C2: among (scenario, budget, Greek) cells where MC and PCA-RQMC differ significantly (95% bootstrap CI of log(wn_MC/wn_PCA) over replications excludes 0), the rule picks the better of the two in >= 90%
success_criteria.C3: the rule's geometric-mean regret is no worse than both comparators (frequency heuristic, always-PCA) in at least 2/3 of (budget, Greek) cells
success_criteria.verdict: pass if C1 and C2 hold; C3 reported but not required
